keys.description: the broker carrying the bots' segment hints (transcription_segments), the collector's verified feeds (tc:meeting:{row}, read only) and signals' own keys (sig:*, signals the only writer)

agent-api's internal door: each meeting's listening brief and the company's signal policy, in one answer (GET /internal/meetings/{row}/listen?subject=<owner>). Without it signals cannot know it is switched on, so it refuses to boot rather than idle silently
the internal tier's secret: sent to agent-api on the brief read, and to flows-api on POST /events/signal with X-Vexa-Service: signals (the only door a wake goes through)

flows' address — the domain signals HANDS its wakes to (event.v1 meeting.signal, POST /events/signal, authenticated with INTERNAL_API_SECRET + X-Vexa-Service: signals). A publish, not a dependency: unset is the no-flows profile and wakes are dropped
the credential broker, where the signal model's company key lives (model_signals.secret_ref broker:signals/<name>)
file holding the broker's signals role key (the broker holds the same file as VEXA_CONNECTIONS_SIGNALS_KEY_FILE); it opens POST /api/internal/signals/model-key and nothing else
`dev` alone allows the development key fallback below; any other value never reads it
DEVELOPMENT ONLY, read only when VEXA_ENV=dev and the broker holds no key for the policy's name: an OpenRouter key for the signal model. Production keys live in the credential broker
the operator's price estimate per million tokens of the signal model, the basis of the per-source cost cap (signals_cost_per_meeting_usd)
the replay tool only (python -m meeting_signals.replay --model-signals …), never the service: the key for a real signal model while replaying a transcript by hand
the port of GET /health (liveness and what this instance listens to)
this instance's name on leases and consumer groups; unique per replica

model_key.description: the signal model's key is read from the credential broker (signals role)
model_key.when_unconfigured: a model_signals with secret_ref broker:signals/<name> cannot be keyed: lines are buffered unscored and the log names the fix (VEXA_ENV=dev may use SIGNALS_OPENROUTER_API_KEY); secret_ref none still works
